Option C feels best. I like seeing each tag as a removable pill, with matching tags I’ve used before suggested as I type, while still being able to create a new one.

Keeping my note separate from the page description is exactly right. I’d like notes to support simple formatting—such as headings, lists, links, and emphasis—and display that formatting when I view the bookmark. Tags and the note should also be editable later, alongside the title and description.
